summary: Phase 8 Testing Complete - All 7 requested features verified working. Print on Demand page exists at /print-on-demand with 8 products, dropdown navigation works in header, Pet Owner Club tab navigation scrolls to content correctly, Admin Users Management has search/filters, Admin Orders has search/type/date filters, Admin Categories has search/collection filter, Admin Products shows gallery upload section for POD collection.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 7 tasks from Phase 8 verified working. Print on Demand page shows products with category filters. Pet Owner Club tab navigation scrolls correctly. Admin panel enhanced with search/filters for Users, Orders, and Categories. Gallery upload section appears when selecting POD collection in Products form.

print_on_demand_page.details: Page exists at /print-on-demand with data-testid='print-on-demand-page'. Shows 8 POD products. Has search input (data-testid='pod-search-input') and category tabs (all, canvas, framed, posters, gifts). Each product shows image, price, discount, rating, and 'Customizable' badge.

print_on_demand_dropdown_navigation.details: Header navigation includes 'Print on Demand' link with hover dropdown showing: Canvas Prints, Framed Art, Posters, Photo Gifts, All Print on Demand. Dropdown visible on hover with proper styling.

pet_owner_club_tab_scroll.details: Tab navigation at /pet-owner-club works correctly. Three tabs: Community Forum, Member Benefits, Membership Plans. Clicking tabs scrolls to #club-content section. Each tab loads appropriate content - Forum Categories, Benefits grid, and Pricing plans.

admin_users_management.details: Users Management page (data-testid='admin-users-manager') has: Search input (data-testid='user-search-input'), Role filter (data-testid='role-filter'), Membership filter (data-testid='membership-filter'), Export CSV button. Stats cards show Total Users, Admins, Premium, VIP Members. Users table with columns: User, Role, Membership, Signup Date, Last Login, Status, Actions.

admin_orders_search_filter.details: Orders page (data-testid='admin-orders-manager') has: Search input (data-testid='order-search-input'), Status filter (data-testid='status-filter'), Type filter (data-testid='type-filter'), Date filter (data-testid='date-filter'). Shows 6 orders with $452 revenue. Stats cards for Total Orders, Revenue, Pending, Confirmed.

admin_categories_search_filter.details: Categories page (data-testid='admin-categories-manager') has: Search input (data-testid='category-search-input'), Collection filter (data-testid='collection-filter'), Add Category button (data-testid='add-category-btn'). Shows 13 categories with color-coded collection badges (POD=orange, Digital=blue, Pet Care=green).

admin_products_gallery_upload_pod.details: When Print on Demand collection is selected in Add/Edit Product form, orange-themed 'Product Gallery Images' section appears. Has '+Add' button for uploading images. Shows text: 'Add multiple images showing different angles, sizes, or variations of your print product'. Also shows 'Customizable (Allow customer uploads)' checkbox specific to POD.
